text: dsh-tool-terminal-search 是为 DeepSeek Harness 添加终端滚屏搜索的工具插件。启用 bundle 后，terminal_search 通过 DSH 的 terminals.read 接口查找保留输出中的字面文本或正则匹配行。结果按最新优先排序，包含可继续读取的偏移、匹配总数和截断状态，并支持分页。适合从长命令输出中定位错误；需有官方终端服务，不需 API key。

dsh-tool-terminal-search adds terminal_search to DSH. It reads retained output through terminals.read and finds literal or regular-expression matches. Results are newest first with reusable offsets and match counts. Enable the bundle and provide the official terminal service; no API key is needed.
想直接在终端历史输出里搜某个错误关键词。
能不能按正则找出持久终端里最新的匹配行？
Find matching lines in retained terminal output and jump to their offsets.
dsh-tool-terminal-search 的功能「搜索终端滚屏」：在保留的终端输出中按字面子串或正则匹配行。调用 terminal_search 并传入会话、模式及可选分页参数，返回最新优先的匹配行和偏移。
dsh-tool-terminal-search 的功能「限定搜索结果」：可用 offset 和 limit 翻页查看匹配项，结果包含匹配数与保留行数；过大的文本按配置字节上限截断并标示状态。
dsh-tool-terminal-search 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 70 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · dsh-tool-terminal-search：[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A `terminal_search` tool plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh): locate lines in large retained terminal scrollback by literal substring or regular expression, without paging backward blindly through tens of thousands of log lines.

The tool is composed **only** over the public `ctx.terminals.read` seam — no upstream package changes, so it runs on published dsh releases today.

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Why：`terminal_read` pages retained scrollback by newest-relative `offset`/`count`. With backend log output running to tens of thousands of lines, a model cannot tell where the interesting lines are: it has to page backward from the newest output one page at a time, and `totalLines` alone does not locate a needle in the retained buffer. `terminal_search` closes that gap by finding lines by content.

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Install：Install with the dsh CLI — it forwards pnpm into the profile directory — then add the package to the profile's `bundles` list. The bundle's own patch then contributes `terminal_search` automatically:

```sh
dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Installs into the profile's node_modules (dsh plugin forwards to pnpm).：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tool-terminal-search
section: Installs into the profile's node_modules (dsh plugin forwards to pnpm).

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Verify the install.：The official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-terminal` plugin (and the `dsh-terminal` / `dsh-terminal-bash` services) must still be present for `terminal_open` / `terminal_send` / `terminal_read`.

Restart your dsh profile. The model gains `terminal_search` next to the official `terminal_open` / `terminal_send` / `terminal_read` tools.

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Behavior：- Pages the whole retained scrollback (newest → oldest) through `terminal_read` and matches each line.
- `pattern` is a **literal substring** by default (grep `-F` style) — no regex metacharacters to escape; pass `regex: true` to treat it as a JavaScript regular expression. Compiled regexes go through a process-wide bounded FIFO cache (oldest entries evicted first), so repeated patterns never recompile.
- Returns matching lines **newest first**, each with a newest-relative `offset` that is directly usable as a `terminal_read` offset (jump to a match's context in one follow-up call).
- Returns the exact `matchCount`, the retained `totalLines`, and `truncated`; `offset`/`limit` page over matches.
- Renders `[offset N] line` per match plus `[search: X of Y matches, Z retained lines]`; results are capped by `maxResultBytes` (default `262144`).

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Known limitations：- One search pages the bounded scrollback in memory (`scrollbackLines` 10 000 / `scrollbackMaxBytes` 4 MiB by default), so it only sees retained lines — same contract as `terminal_read`.
- A page whose bytes exceed the backend `maxReadBytes` is reread with a smaller page size so line offsets stay exact; a single line larger than `maxReadBytes` degrades to a truncated line and sets `truncated`.
- No surrounding-context lines are returned; read around a match's offset for context.
- Requires the dsh `0.1.2-alpha.5` release line (the package's peer range resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` at `^0.1.2-alpha.5`, so it composes against newer 0.1.2-alpha.x builds of the same read contract).

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit
npm test            # vitest
npm run build       # esbuild bundle + tsc declarations into lib/

dsh-tool-terminal-search README · Relationship to upstream：An equivalent native implementation (same tool name, schema, and coordinate space) is tracked upstream in [deepseek-harness discussion #1025](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1025). This plugin lets deployments use the capability today; switching to the native backend later is transparent.
